import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] a = new int[5];
        int n = 0;
        int sum = 0;
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        int i = 0;
        do {
            a[i] = scanner.nextInt();
            sum += a[i];
            i++;
        } while (i < n);
        System.out.println(sum / n);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
